title: Henry V / Timon of Athens

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Let type scale communicate hierarchy because a title and a performance time have different reading jobs.
strategic_value: The enormous V and 8 PM can make the poster both dramatic and practical.
demonstration: Black lettering fills an orange-to-yellow field with a dominant V above TIMON OF ATHENS and a large 8 PM at left.
practical_value: Compare expressive title letters with an unusually prominent time cue.

content_islands.name: Upper title and time
content_islands.spec: Make V the main mass, with HENRY above and 8 PM beside it.

content_islands.name: Lower program
content_islands.spec: Stack TIMON OF ATHENS below and fit supporting information into narrow edge columns.
